text_block_list.text:
While taking a break at our destination 
during a drive with Maruzensky...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, look, look! There's a crêpe stand!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Agreed~. It's just the right time for a 
snack anyway.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Let's order different things and split 
them, Trainer-kun."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Let's order different things and split 
them, Trainer-chan."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll have the tiramisu crepe! 
Trainer-kun, pick whatever you like too~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll have the tiramisu crepe! 
Trainer-chan, pick whatever you like too~♪

I enjoyed a delicious crêpe together with 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that was delicious! My mouth is 
full of pure happiness~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I got to see your happy face 
too, Trainer-kun. Fufu, thanks for the 
treat♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I got to see your happy face 
too, Trainer-chan. Fufu, thanks for the 
treat♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Today... or should I say, today as well? 
Thanks for hanging out with me.
choice_data_list: The main thing is that they're happy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Going out with someone really is fun after 
all. I always end up bored when I'm on my 
own.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Not many girls can handle coming on drives 
with her, though. They say they can't keep 
up with her speed, or whatever...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Without Trainer-kun, every day might have 
been so lonely...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer-chan wasn't here, every day 
might have been so lonely...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hmm, I've never really thought about 
it that much, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You might be right. We had maids back 
home, so it was always lively around the 
house.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps growing up that way is why I feel 
at ease when I'm with someone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I've gotten used to living on my own, 
though to begin with, I hardly spend much 
time at home."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see. Guess I was just lonely~
choice_data_list:
I guess I got to see an unexpected side of 
you.

Whenever you're lonely, I'll keep you 
company again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. Oh dear, my big secret 
has been discovered~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Keep this a secret from everyone, okay? 
After all, I'm the dependable big sister, 
you know."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I trust that you'll take good care 
of me, though♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I trust that you'll take good care 
of me, though♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! In return, tell me a secret 
too, Trainer-kun! Then we'll be even!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! In return, tell me a secret 
too, Trainer-chan! Then we'll be even!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, that's not fair! That's totally 
unfair, boo, boooo!

Spending time with Maruzensky made me feel 
like we'd grown closer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks♪ You really are kind, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks♪ You really are so sweet, Trainie.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The reason I never realized how lonely of 
a person I am until now was surely thanks 
to that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because whenever I go to the academy, 
you're there, everyone else is there, and 
I always have a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:

you're there, everyone else is there, and 
I always have a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you're right... Now that I've 
realized it, maybe I'll let myself be 
pampered a little more.”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then please! I haven't run enough yet, so 
come along for a little more driving♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I feel lonely, all I have to 
do is tell you and you'll give me proper 
attention, right?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I feel lonely, all I have to 
do is tell you and you'll give me proper 
attention, right?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yay, Big Sis is so touched♪ All right~, 
time to turn up the speed even more~!

Afterward, we ended up enjoying a drive 
until the sun went down...
